integrity: All seven included files have decoded-byte SHA-256 and length checks; the finite verifier is a reproducibility check, not a substitute for the analytical central limit proof. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for uniform perfect matchings; no rate, local limit or extreme-value conclusion is claimed. The finite joint distribution is already encoded by the bivariate generating function of Kasraoui and Zeng. Priority of the explicit bivariate Gaussian limit remains subject to further historical full-text comparison.
title: Asymptotic independence of crossing-pair and nesting-pair counts in uniform matchings
